result.title: Metric-Dependent Scaling Laws for Sketched Multiclass Softmax Regression
result.summary: We study scaling laws for full-batch gradient descent with general stable deterministic learning rates in sketched multiclass softmax regression. In a Gaussian teacher student model with power law feature and teacher spectra, the student observes a random feature sketch and reuses a finite labeled sample throughout optimization. Sketching generally makes the student misspecified, so the analysis must jointly account for approximation, nonlinear finite time learning, and the fixed empirical perturbation induced by data reuse. On an exponentially likely sketch event, we show that cross entropy excess and excess zero one risk share a common spectral scale, consisting of a resolution term and an effective learned dimension divided by sample size; teacher student decision disagreement follows the square root of that scale. The resulting balance gives rate optimal sketch and cumulative horizon choices, and synthetic experiments support the predicted regimes and metric dependent exponents.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在 Gaussian teacher-student 模型下分析随机特征 sketch 下多类 softmax 回归的 full-batch 梯度下降缩放律，给出交叉熵与零一风险的谱尺度分解，并推导最优的 sketch 分辨率与训练时长选择。
